labels.quote: JPMorgan's net income rose 31.5% from $37.7 billion in 2022 to $49.6 billion in 2023.
Total net revenue was $158.1 billion in 2023.
Noninterest expense was $87.2 billion in 2023, equal to 61.3% of total net revenue of $158.1 billion.
Total net revenue increased 22.9% from $128.7 billion in 2022 to $158.1 billion in 2023.
